faqs.question: Do I need an appointment or can I walk in?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking an appointment via call or WhatsApp to minimize wait time, though walk-ins are accommodated based on availability.

faqs.question: What are your working hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We're closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Is teeth whitening safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, when done professionally under supervision. We use dentist-grade whitening agents that are safe for enamel with proper aftercare guidance.

faqs.question: How painful is a root canal treatment?
faqs.answer: With modern anesthesia and rotary technology, most patients report little to no pain during the procedure, and mild discomfort for a day or two after.

faqs.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, dental implants can last 15-20 years or even a lifetime.

faqs.question: Do you accept health insurance?
faqs.answer: We accept select insurance panels. Please contact our front desk with your insurance provider details to confirm coverage.

faqs.question: Do you offer installment plans?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer flexible installment plans for orthodontic and implant treatments.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get a crown or bridge made?
faqs.answer: Since we have an in-house lab, most crowns and bridges are ready within 3-5 working days.

faqs.question: Do you accept lab work from other dental clinics?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept outsourced lab cases from referring dentists. Please contact us directly for turnaround times and pricing.
